_meta.ptally/summary: Explains one quote: which rules fired, how each step built the price, what every step produced and how long it took. Works on a saved quote or one you paste in.
_meta.swallow/summary: Explains one quote: which rules fired, how each step built the price, what every step produced and how long it took. Works on a saved quote or one you paste in.

description: Review one quote in a standard shape, from a stored `quote_reference` (get_quotes) or a pasted `quote` — the dashboard's Copy JSON, a POST /quotes or run_quote response, or a bare engine output with `debug` (`quote_gz`: base64 gzip of the same JSON, for big pastes). Pass exactly one. Returns `{ source, quote_reference, project_reference, project_name, version_reference, version, created_at, outcome: { decision (quoted | declined | referred | error), result, valid, status, error, exec_time_ms, engine_time_ms, steps, slowest_steps }, input, output, rules: { exclusions, refers, excesses, endorsements: { fired_count, checked_count, fired: [{ step, name, exp, values, result }] } }, result_build: { formula, values, result }, valid_rule: { exp, values, result }, build: [{ order, id, name, type, description, ms, logic: [{ name, exp | formula, values, result }], lookups, table_rows, output, errors }], errors, has_trace, truncated, amendment, quote_url, version_url, replay, how_to_explain, next_steps }`. `outcome` is always what the engine priced. `amendment` (stored quotes only; null when never touched) is `{ result, valid, sold, amended_at, log: [{ when, who, via (dashboard | api | mcp), result: { from, to }, valid, sold, note }] }`: the price, validity or sold flag someone set afterwards (dashboard, API or amend_quote), and the log of who changed what. Step names, types, descriptions and collection lookups come from the version's model when it is on this instance. A quote without a step trace is re-priced against its version (`replay: true` forces it); `replay` reports the replayed vs stored result and whether they match. Nothing is saved. Responses are kept under ~80 KB: large quotes come back clipped or as an overview (`truncated` says which) — pass `steps: [<id>, …]` for those steps in full. If even the overview is too big the result is `{ too_large: true, outcome, rules counts, next_steps }`: review a few steps at a time, or ask the user to paste the part they want explained. Explain the result back following `how_to_explain`.

quote.description: A pasted quote: the dashboard's Copy JSON, a POST /quotes or run_quote response, or an engine output with `debug`. A JSON string is also accepted.

quote_gz.description: Base64-encoded gzip of the quote JSON, instead of `quote` when it is too big to pass inline.

quote_reference.description: A stored quote's reference, from get_quotes.

replay.description: Optional. Re-price the quote's input against its version even when it has a step trace, and compare with the stored result. Never saved.

steps.description: Optional. Step ids to return in full (and only those in `build`). Use after a truncated review, or to focus on one step.

name: get_quote
title: Review a quote
